_note: I051: note corrections found while writing docs/code/vram-dma-hdma-palettes.md. (1) The RunSoulOfLightEffect note put the dark place in 'Woods of GreenWood B1F and Lostside'; the walkthrough (items.md, 03-greenwood.md) gets the Soul of Light in the Woods of GreenWood and needs it on B1F of the Light Shrine, which is entered from the Lostside marsh (OQ-I051-1, DISCREPANCY). (2) BuildSoulOrbCircleWindow ends its tables with one line whose edges are both $FF (WH0 = WH1 = $FF, a window one pixel wide at x = 255), not a 'full-width' line (OQ-I051-3). (3) The seabed and sanctuary wave notes called the PPU registers $0D, $0E and $0F 'channels'; they are the registers passed to QueueHdmaIndirect, the channel is chosen by the queue (OQ-I051-7). (4) The iris notes described one circle; the iris rewrites BG3 tile 0 with a 2-bit 8 x 8 mask and the whole BG3 page is made of tile 0, so the screen shows a grid of squares that closes and opens (OQ-I051-11).

edit.find: closed by a full-width line and a zero terminator
edit.with: closed by one line with both edges $FF (WH0 = WH1 = $FF, a window one pixel wide at x = 255, OQ-I051-3) and a zero terminator

edit.find: (the walkthrough says it lets the player see in the dark areas of Woods of GreenWood B1F and Lostside; what the window clips is OQ-I042-2)
edit.with: (the walkthrough gets the soul in the Woods of GreenWood and needs it on B1F of the Light Shrine, which is entered from the Lostside marsh; the registers withhold colour math inside the circle, a reading of the bits that OQ-I051-2 asks to check; what the window clips is OQ-I042-2)

edit.find: closed by a one-line full-width entry and a zero)
edit.with: closed by a one-line entry with both edges $FF, a window one pixel wide at x = 255 (OQ-I051-3), and a zero)

edit.find: Sees: a circle closes on the player (out) or opens (in).
edit.with: Sees: a grid of small squares over the whole screen that fills in (out) or opens into holes (in); the same 8 x 8 mask is in every cell of the BG3 page, so it is not one circle around the player (OQ-I051-11 for the colour).

edit.find: Sees: a circle that closes in on the screen and opens again.
edit.with: Sees: a grid of squares over the whole screen that fills in and opens into holes again (frame $00 is solid, $1F empty; the same 8 x 8 mask in every cell of the BG3 page, not one circle).
